facts.value: Bachelor's certificate with grade overview (for foreign certificates: please provide a certified copy in English or German), study exposé, CV, copy of the high school diploma, for foreign applicants: proof of DSH examination (DSH-2) in certified form, for applicants from Vietnam, People's Republic of China, and India: APS certificate (original only), proof of English language skills at a B2 level of the 'Common European Framework of Reference for Languages of the Council of Europe'
